Game changesWiki changes

Selected updates through 13 October 2026.

13 October 2026

  • Updated the guides for LAN play, doors, survival milestones and aiming.
  • Fixed the door and sailing references.
  • Added topic pages and clearer links between guides.
  • Changed gallery images to load smaller previews, with full-size views available when opened.
  • Added game and wiki changelogs.
  • Fixed the quick-craft instructions for X.
  • Updated portraits for all 94 animals, including Swan.
  • Changed the home and navigation to focus on biomes, mobs and items.

12 October 2026

  • Added catalogs of blocks and animals.
  • Added guides to building, sailing, hunting, weather, caves and exploration.
  • Added help for doors, chests, blueprints and the structure library.
  • Fixed recipe amounts and descriptions of controls, materials and sound.
  • Updated the multiplayer guide for LAN hosting and saved inventory.
  • Added help for startup, sound and save problems.

11 October 2026

  • Added getting-started guides, controls, crafting recipes and installation help.
  • Added shared navigation and offline search.
  • Changed the wiki to cover the base game only and fixed missing report links.

9 October 2026

  • Published the biome, animal and island atlas as a standalone wiki.

About this list

Selected wiki changes from 9 October 2026 to 13 October 2026. Dates follow the recorded history; they are not numbered releases. Early entries sometimes group several changes.
